<div class="card-body">
'''Vaporator''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヴァーポレーター</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、タトゥイーンの位置カードのどれかに配備する。移動不可。同じまたは隣接した位置カードにいるすべてのキャラクターは、「砂岩嵐」から防御される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-41o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">砂漠の惑星には必要不可欠。大気中から水蒸気を凝集させる機械。浄化フィルターと冷却剤タンク付き。干ばつや苛酷な環境への対抗手段。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Vaporator.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy at any Tatooine location. Cannot move. All characters at the same or an adjacent location are protected from Sandwhirl.

'''Lore:''' An essential machine on desert planets that condenses water vapor from the air. It has a purification filter and coolant tank, and helps people cope with drought and harsh conditions.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Vaporator]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
